content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Sb 0.22 / Zn 0.78) as the best composition. The result is weak, though: its EQE was only 0.00069%, and none of the three compositions I measured produced a real photoresponse.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 0.68 | −0.0032 |
| 25 | 0.81 | −0.0019 |
| 0 | 0.22 | +0.00069 |

**How I chose the points:** XRD at Sb 0.42, 0.68 and 0.81 showed the same pattern each time, matching the ZnSb2O6-type crystal structure. The Sb-rich samples also had a few extra small peaks, likely from some Sb oxide. ZnSb2O6 has a wide band gap, so it should absorb little of the 2.1 eV illumination. That fits the near-zero readings at the two Sb-rich points. I used the last merit measurement on the Zn-rich end, the most different part of the library. Its composition matches Zn7Sb2O12, another listed phase, but I didn't take XRD there to confirm it.

**What wasn't covered:** I measured merit at only 3 of the 28 compositions, which was the whole budget. Nothing between Sb 0.22 and 0.68 was measured. With the entire line near zero, index 0 is the best by a tiny margin, but a better composition could still be somewhere in that middle stretch. I also used only 3 of the 5 XRD measurements.
